name: 表级 IO 等待分析
description: performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_table 记录了每个表的读写 IO 等待统计，包括 fetch（读行）、insert、update、delete 各操作的等待时间和次数。通过此表可以快速定位 IO 热点表——哪些表被频繁读写、哪些表的 IO 等待时间最长。这是 SQL 优化和索引优化的重要输入。

signals.desc: 某些表的 IO 等待总时间远高于其他表
物理读次数偏高，需要定位热点表

conditions.desc: 需要定位 IO 热点表时手动触发

skip_when.desc: 实例刚启动，统计数据不足

root_causes.name: 热点表缺少索引导致全表扫描
root_causes.desc: 某些表 COUNT_FETCH 极高但实际业务访问量不大，说明存在全表扫描。每次查询扫描大量行导致 IO 等待累积。

root_causes.name: 高频写入表成为 IO 瓶颈
root_causes.desc: 日志表、流水表等高频写入表 COUNT_INSERT 和 SUM_TIMER_INSERT 很高，写入 IO 成为瓶颈。

root_causes.name: 大表频繁更新导致随机 IO
root_causes.desc: 大表的 UPDATE 操作涉及随机页读写，COUNT_UPDATE 和 SUM_TIMER_UPDATE 都很高。

root_causes.name: 临时表 IO 过高
root_causes.desc: 复杂查询创建大量磁盘临时表，临时表的 IO 等待较高。

step1_top_io_tables.desc: IO 等待时间 TOP 20 的表
step1_top_io_tables.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, COUNT_STAR AS total_io_ops, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS total_wait_sec, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_FETCH/1e12, 2) AS fetch_wait_sec, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_INSERT/1e12, 2) AS insert_wait_sec, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_UPDATE/1e12, 2) AS update_wait_sec, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_DELETE/1e12, 2) AS delete_wait_sec FROM performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_table WHERE OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'sys', 'performance_schema', 'information_schema') ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_WAIT DESC LIMIT 20

step2_top_read_tables.desc: 读操作 IO 最高的表
step2_top_read_tables.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, COUNT_FETCH AS read_ops, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_FETCH/1e12, 2) AS read_wait_sec, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_FETCH/GREATEST(COUNT_FETCH, 1)/1e9, 2) AS avg_read_ms FROM performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_table WHERE OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'sys', 'performance_schema', 'information_schema') AND COUNT_FETCH > 0 ORDER BY SUM_TIMER_FETCH DESC LIMIT 20

step3_top_write_tables.desc: 写操作 IO 最高的表
step3_top_write_tables.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, COUNT_INSERT + COUNT_UPDATE + COUNT_DELETE AS write_ops, ROUND((SUM_TIMER_INSERT + SUM_TIMER_UPDATE + SUM_TIMER_DELETE)/1e12, 2) AS write_wait_sec FROM performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_table WHERE OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'sys', 'performance_schema', 'information_schema') ORDER BY (SUM_TIMER_INSERT + SUM_TIMER_UPDATE + SUM_TIMER_DELETE) DESC LIMIT 20

step4_index_io_waits.desc: 按索引维度查看 IO 等待（定位缺索引）
step4_index_io_waits.sql: SELECT OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, INDEX_NAME, COUNT_STAR AS io_ops, ROUND(SUM_TIMER_WAIT/1e12, 2) AS wait_sec FROM performance_schema.table_io_waits_summary_by_index_usage WHERE OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql', 'sys', 'performance_schema', 'information_schema') AND INDEX_NAME IS NULL ORDER BY COUNT_STAR DESC LIMIT 20
step4_index_io_waits.version_note: INDEX_NAME IS NULL 表示全表扫描

step5_sys_io_by_table.desc: 通过 sys schema 查看表 IO 统计（更友好的格式）
step5_sys_io_by_table.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name, rows_fetched, fetch_latency, rows_inserted, insert_latency, rows_updated, update_latency, rows_deleted, delete_latency, io_read, io_write FROM sys.schema_table_statistics ORDER BY io_read_latency + io_write_latency DESC LIMIT 20

real_world_examples.scenario: 通过表级 IO 分析发现日志表拖慢整个实例
real_world_examples.symptoms: 整体查询响应时间变慢，但无明显慢查询。table_io_waits 分析发现 audit_log 表的 insert_wait_sec 占总 IO 等待的 60%
real_world_examples.root_cause: 每个 API 请求同步插入一条审计日志，audit_log 表 INSERT 频率 5000/s，写入 IO 成为瓶颈影响其他表的读写
real_world_examples.resolution: 审计日志改为异步批量写入（攒满 100 条或每 1 秒写一次），INSERT 频率降到 50/s
real_world_examples.result: audit_log 的 insert_wait_sec 降低 95%，整体查询响应时间恢复正常
